criteria.description: Create the 12 taxonomy labels with titles matching the design doc exactly.
criteria.evidence: WP01 TAXONOMY_LABELS declares the 12 titles (create_taxonomy_labels.py); create pass issues PUT /labels for each absent title. test_create_from_empty asserts 12 created; test_fidelity_declared_titles_match_expected_set compares against a literal expected set (not a tautology).
criteria.notes: Live label creation is the post-merge operational run.

criteria.description: Each created label carries its assigned color; colors added to the design doc.
criteria.evidence: PUT body includes hex_color from TAXONOMY_LABELS. Color column added to all 4 label tables in docs/design/vikunja-configuration-design.md (values match data-model). Fidelity test asserts declared colors equal the expected set.
criteria.notes: Design doc remains the taxonomy authority (post-plan finding #1).

criteria.description: Creation and deletion performed by a single deterministic tested helper (one CLI).
criteria.evidence: One module scripts/vikunja/create_taxonomy_labels.py with argparse CLI; no agent-improvised API calls. Reviewer confirmed deterministic reconcile on VikunjaClient, no requests, no new HTTP path.
criteria.notes: Operational sequence may invoke the one helper multiple times.

criteria.description: Idempotent: re-run makes zero changes and exits 0.
criteria.evidence: test_idempotent_rerun_* asserts 0 puts / 0 deletes / exit 0 against fully-present state.

criteria.description: Delete exactly the 3 legacy labels; all exact-title matches.
criteria.evidence: LEGACY_TITLES case-sensitive; delete pass deletes every matching id. test_delete_all_matches_for_duplicate_legacy covers duplicate titles.
criteria.notes: Live deletion is the backup-gated post-merge run.

criteria.description: Deletion requires explicit flag AND a backup-confirmation reference, echoed in output.
criteria.evidence: main refuses (exit 2, zero delete calls) when --delete-legacy present and --backup-confirmed absent (test_delete_refused_without_backup_ref_no_delete_calls). backup_confirmed echoed in --json (test_delete_with_backup_ref_deletes_and_echoes).

criteria.description: Per-label outcome reported for every label touched.
criteria.evidence: ReconcileOutcome per label (created/already-present/color-mismatch/deleted/already-absent/skipped-no-flag/duplicate-title/delete-inconsistent); default table + --json emit them.
criteria.notes: delete-inconsistent action added for the INV-8 path (review nit).

criteria.description: Emit the taxonomy label->id map on success.
criteria.evidence: --json emits label_id_map for the 12 titles. Consumed by #717 migration.

criteria.description: Paginate label list (per_page<=50); mutate by id, not title.
criteria.evidence: list_labels pages GET /labels per_page=50 stopping on short/empty page (test_pagination_*); deletes by resolved id.

criteria.description: Duplicate taxonomy title -> fail non-zero, report all ids, no ambiguous mutation.
criteria.evidence: Create pass records duplicate-title with all ids, sets failed, continues without mutation (test_duplicate_title_*).

criteria.description: Already-present taxonomy label with wrong color -> color-mismatch, non-zero exit.
criteria.evidence: Create pass compares normalized colors; mismatch -> color-mismatch + failed, no put (test_color_mismatch_*). Cannot occur on first live run (all created fresh).
37 tests in tests/vikunja/test_create_taxonomy_labels.py, all paths + Timeout/Auth/Server surfaced; 92.65% branch coverage (threshold 90%). No real network (urlopen guard).

criteria.description: Second full run makes 0 create and 0 delete operations.
criteria.evidence: Idempotency tests assert zero mutations on re-run.

criteria.description: Full run completes <=30s under normal latency.
criteria.evidence: 12 create + 3 delete API calls, no heavy work; verified during the post-merge operational run (quickstart).
